name: Danaher
description: Danaher sells the instruments, and especially the consumables and services that go with them, used to discover and make drugs and to diagnose disease. Biotechnology (Cytiva and Pall bioprocessing filters, resins and equipment for drugmakers), Life Sciences (research instruments, antibodies, custom DNA and RNA) and Diagnostics (Beckman Coulter, Cepheid, Radiometer, Leica Biosystems) each earn money from an installed base of equipment that needs frequent replacement consumables, such as reagents, chromatography resins and filters. Diagnostics is 41% of sales and 53% of segment profit; Life Sciences earned only a 7.1% margin in 2025 after a fall from 12.0%. On 2026-06-10 it bought patient-monitoring company Masimo for about $9.8 billion in cash, placed in Diagnostics.

employees.note: About 60,000 associates: about 22,000 in North America, 20,000 in Western Europe, 3,000 in other developed markets, 15,000 in high-growth markets.

businessLines.name: Diagnostics
businessLines.how: Sells clinical and molecular testing instruments to hospitals and labs and then the reagents and other consumables used on every test, plus service and software.

businessLines.name: Life Sciences
businessLines.how: Sells research and drug-development instruments (centrifugation, automated liquid handling, cell culture and analytical technologies) and consumables such as antibodies, plasmid DNA and custom oligonucleotides to pharma, biotech and universities; instruments one-time, consumables repeat.

businessLines.name: Biotechnology
businessLines.how: Sells bioprocessing equipment, filters, resins and consumables that drugmakers use to manufacture biologics, mostly repeat consumable purchases tied to production runs, plus a discovery and medical business.

brands.name: Cytiva and Pall
brands.note: Biotechnology segment key brands ($7,293M segment, 29.7% of sales); company-level brand sales not broken out.

brands.name: Beckman Coulter, Cepheid, Radiometer, Leica Biosystems, HemoCue, Mammotome
brands.note: Diagnostics segment key brands ($9,941M segment, 40.5% of sales); brand revenues not broken out.

brands.name: Abcam, Aldevron, IDT, SCIEX, Molecular Devices, Phenomenex, Leica Microsystems, Genedata
brands.note: Life Sciences segment key brands ($7,334M segment, 29.9% of sales); brand revenues not broken out.

brands.name: Masimo Corporation
brands.note: Acquired 2026-06-10 for about $9.8 billion cash ($180.00 per share) net of cash acquired; patient monitoring technologies; 2025 revenue about $1.5 billion; now in Diagnostics.
